{{Quote|If I die for them at least I will die with honor, and perhaps some will remember me fondly. If not, I die at home, an outcast.|Rych Ha'andeely, on working for the Hutts|<ref name="EGAS" />}}
'''Rych Ha'andeelay''' was a [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] who faced [[Speciesism/Legends|prejudice]] from members of his [[Species/Legends|species]] for having characteristics of two Nikto [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]]. His treatment was noted in [[sentientologist]] [[Tem Eliss]]'s [[Book/Legends|book]] ''[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life]]''.

==Biography==
{{Quote|On Nar Shaddaa, there was one young Nikto who showed characteristics of two of the Nikto races. His name was Rych Ha'andeelay.|Tem Eliss, in ''The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life''|<ref name="EGAS" />}}
[[File:Nar_Shaddaa_LoNH.png|thumb|right|270px|Rych Ha'andeelay was born on Nar Shaddaa (pictured).]]
Rych Ha'andeelay was a young<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']] </ref> [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] whose [[Reproduction/Legends|birthplace]] was<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="CSWE" /> Among the Nikto, Ha'andeelay was an outcast because he had characteristics of two Nikto [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] and was unable to get work with them. Because of this, he gladly took the opportunity to work for members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]].<ref name="EGAS" /> 

Ha'andeelay's circumstances were documented as an example of the special [[Speciesism/Legends|prejudice]] Nikto exhibited by<ref name="EGAS" /> author and [[sentientologist]]<ref name="GalaxyGuide12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref> [[Tem Eliss]]<ref name="EGAS" /> in his [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]] [[Book/Legends|book]]<ref name="GalaxyGuide12" /> ''[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life]]''. In the book, Ha'andeelay was noted as saying he would [[Death/Legends|die]] with honor working for the Hutts and not with living among the Nikto. Eliss's work was reused by [[Senior Anthropologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]] in the Nikto section of ''[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'', a guide on [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] published with the help of a [[Ann Margaret Lewis|professional writer]] no earlier than [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].<ref name="EGAS" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|This young Nikto showed scars on his arms and legs, where he had been slashed with a knife, and burn scars on his arms.|Tem Eliss|<ref name="EGAS" />}}
An unusual member of his [[Species/Legends|species]], Ha'andeelay showed traits of two separate Nikto subspecies.<ref name="CSWE" /> His [[Limb/Legends|arms]] and legs were scarred with [[Knife/Legends|knife]] slashings, and his arms also had burn scars.<ref name="EGAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rych Ha'andeelay was first mentioned in the [[2001]] reference book [[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']], written by [[Ann Margaret Lewis (real person)|Ann Margaret Lewis]].<ref name="EGAS" />
